firmware.title: Pravetz (eCat)
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, Mikhail Revzin
firmware.description: The Bulgarian Pravetz-82, -8M, -8A and -8C (Apple II) and the Pravetz-8D (Oric). Emulated by eCat3; ROMs are built in.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard. F11: file browser, F12: settings; a key at power-on picks the model.
